title: SSE scan_from comment explains only the 4-byte delimiter overlap, not why 3 covers all cases
description:
The scan_from = old_len.saturating_sub(3) comment explains that 3 bytes covers the longest incomplete prefix of the 4-byte delimiter 

. But the code also searches for 

 and  (2-byte delimiters), whose max chunk-boundary overlap is 1 byte. The comment is correct but incomplete: a reader checking the code for the 2-byte cases has to verify independently that 3 >= 1. Add: '3 bytes also covers the 1-byte overlap of the 2-byte 

 and  delimiters.'
